adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the recurring-series deletion path still uses `const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which will delete at most one `_calendar` reference per remaining booking even if `updBooking.references` contains multiple per-host calendar references. Additionally, within that recurring branch it iterates `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter((credential) => credential.type.endsWith("_calendar"))` (the booking owner/organizer’s credentials) rather than iterating over credentials implied by each per-host reference, so other hosts’ calendar events for remaining occurrences can be left undeleted (or deletion may be redundantly repeated due to the new outer loop over `bookingCalendarReference`).
